facts.fact: Niger's data protection authority HAPDP chairs the African Network of Personal Data Protection Authorities (RAPDP) until 2026, presiding over its monthly bureau meetings and annual general assemblies; the interview gives no election date, so the date is its publication, 2025-07-28.
facts.system: Reseau Africain des Autorites de Protection des Donnees Personnelles (RAPDP)

facts.fact: HAPDP says a concertation framework was created between it and the data protection authorities of Burkina Faso and Mali within the AES, on its own initiative; the interview gives no date, so the date is its publication, 2025-07-28.
facts.system: AES data protection authorities concertation framework
